description: This file is the main server setup for a Node.js backend using Express. It configures middleware, sets up API endpoints for health checks, configuration diagnostics, database checks, and integrates route modules for product and billing history management. It also initializes connection to a Supabase backend and starts the server listening on a port.

methods.name: /health endpoint
methods.description: Provides a status check resource indicating server health, port, and environment configuration diagnostics.

methods.name: /api/meta/config endpoint
methods.description: Returns information indicating whether the environment is configured with Supabase credentials.

methods.name: /api/admin/db/check endpoint
methods.description: Performs a safety check to verify the existence of essential database tables in Supabase.
